text:
Avery M: Draft uploaded — added a 'velocity benchmark' section and CTA that points to the webinar sign-up. PTAL: https://drive.google.com/... :eyes:
Priya: Quick skim — numbers look compelling. Are the test details in the appendix?
Carlos: Yep, appendix has harness and infra. Short snippet here:
```
loadgen --model redwood-3b-q4 --seq 1024 --concurrency 64 --batch 8
results: p50=85ms p95=210ms tok/s=4200
```
Priya: Marketing needs a plain-English lead. 'Up to 4x throughput vs baseline' is catchy but legal will want context.
LegalBot: Please define baseline and provide methodology link. 'Up to' is acceptable if accompanied by methodology and a typical-case qualifier. Also include customer-facing disclaimer.
Jen: Ops note — HubSpot UTM we'll use: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch&utm_campaign=velocity_q2&utm_content=webinar` — I'll append to all CTAs.
Ezra: Can we get a 1-2 sentence CTO quote at the top? Draft: "This release slashes inference cost and accelerates time-to-interactive for product teams, unlocking more real-time experiences." Thoughts?
Avery M: Nice. I'll tweak to mention reliability: "...and maintains predictable latency at scale."
Maya: Uploaded visuals: `bench_velocity_v2.png`. Alt text suggestion: "Tokens per second across model sizes on A100 pool with warmed KV cache."
Carlos: Important — call out KV cache state in the caption, otherwise numbers look unrealistic.
Avery M: Good catch. Updated caption to: "KV cache warmed (1k prefix); synthetic load on 8xA100-40GB pool."
Priya: CTA flow: Blog -> Webinar signup modal -> Thank-you page -> HubSpot workflow (welcome series) -> Sales notifies if lead qualifies. I'll attach the workflow screenshot.
Jen: For publish timing: propose Thu 9:00am PT (marketing windows). Need final approvals by 5pm PT today.
LegalBot: Quick pass granted on the 'up to' phrasing given the methods link and typical-case language included. No other holds.
Ezra: PR approves quote and positioning.
Maya: Visuals finalize — small tweak to color contrast done.
Priya: I'll finalize the CTA copy: "See benchmark & sign up for the deep-dive webinar."
Avery M: Final doc link: https://drive.google.com/.../velocity-launch-draft — locking copy at 5pm PT unless any objections.
Carlos: Approved. :thumbsup:
Jen: Approved for publish window. :rocket:
Avery M: Thanks all — scheduling the publish and webinar page updates now.
